protocol.training: Same 390 ESC-50 only; v1 final warm start; same seed5242 and fixed20 epochs for every candidate
protocol.selection: INT8 feasibility: overall >= frozen v1 52/65 and baby > frozen v1 12/20. Among feasible choose highest macro recall, then accuracy, then baby precision. If none feasible do not replace v1.
protocol.external_role: Repeatedly seen user-confirmed DEVELOPMENT set. This is explicitly optimistic development evidence, not a held-out blind-test claim.
protocol.cv: After selecting recipe on external development set, fit the same fixed recipe to each corresponding v1 four-fold initializer and score untouched ESC-50 fold; report as fixed-recipe CV, not nested selection CV.

selection.config_selection_basis: Explicit repeated development-set selection; final blind evaluation still needed
